scope: Complete public scientific operation surfaces of IMSIsotopeDistribution and IMSElement with explicit per-call settings and native checked/owned behavior; no IMSAlphabet or C++ ABI/inheritance claim.

source_literals.distribution_class_test: Only construction/destruction; all numerical sections are TODO. No source convolution numerical goldens claimed.

independently_derived.method: Direct Cartesian species accumulation and closed-form binomial coefficients use small dyadic literals, separately from production destination-bin convolution.

source_conventions: Both source global statics default to zero; native options passed per call.
Raw mass/abundance access and average/normalization ignore SIZE; vectors/stream clamp to SIZE.
Empty right returns unchanged left; empty left copies right before accessing settings.
Power zero and one are no-ops; higher powers retain source binary folding order and empty/SIZE0 quirks.
Nominal u32 wrapping is defined source behavior, replaced by checked atomic overflow error.
Normalization preserves finite signed-zero results after finite-input sum overflow to positive infinity.
Zero-abundance convolution bins discard their numerator, including nonfinite intermediates.
Ordinary native convolution preserves borrowed RHS; explicitly named mutable-RHS variant preserves source padding side effect.

validation.reference_review: Independent read-only source/numeric/resource review by source_analysis; formatter precharge issue resolved before final validation.
